text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Adami hints at development in murder of Raymond Caruana, shot in Nationalist Party club 10 years ago. Adami tells election campaign news conference there could be a development "hopefully soon".
- Alternattiva Demokratika insists doctors should have 40-hour week; small political group presents proposal on health sector at news conference.

- Prime minister says remarks by Labour leader benefit criminals. He and Labour leader Alfred Sant have been trading charges on inaction against criminality as electoral campaign enters final few days.
